source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of stack properties (PDF 95-96).

items: LIFO usool: aakhir mein judi cheez pehle hatti hai.
Ek hi rasta: cheezein sirf top se jurti aur hatti hain.
Tarteeb ki hifazat: jorne ki tarteeb qaim, aakhri pehle bahar.
Size mein lachak: stack ka size muqarrar ho sakta hai ya zaroorat ke mutabiq barh sakta hai.
Tarteeb se pohanch: cheezon tak top se shuru kar ke tarteeb se pohancha jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Stack se beech wali kitab seedhe kyun nahi nikal sakte?
blocks.explanation: Stack ka ek hi rasta hai, top; pehle us ke oopar wali kitabein pop karni hongi.

items: Stack ki khasusiyat: LIFO, ek rasta (top), tarteeb qaim, muqarrar ya barhta size, tarteeb se pohanch.
